Khamoshi se mehnat karo, success shor machaye.
Tumhari ekmatra seema tumhari kalpana hai.
"New life ke liye sirf soch kaafi nahi."
Eyes pe depend nahi, imagination focus karo.
Vishwas rakho ki tum kar sakte ho, aadhi jeet wahi ho gayi.
Challenges accept karo, success milegi.
"Failure se darr nahi; try na karne se darr."
Pressure ko power me badlo.
"Tumhara attitude decide karta—tumhari direction."
Success ek mind ka state hai.
"Humare choices hi batate—hum asli mein kya hain."
